title: 6_The_Outcast
main_characters: Wow! So how did you first find this beach?
I got lost on this hike and ended up here... No one really knows about it.
I come here sometimes when I want to get away from everyone.

quiz.question: What would a typical goth kid like?
quiz.question_short: What would a typical geek like?
options: I didn't know you were into video games...
Uh... I guess... It's kind of hard to admit...
But... I kind of come here to look at the guys.
That's Phil. He totally used to date Mallika...

quiz.question: So... If you're, like, a vampire, does that mean you can't go out in the daytime?
quiz.question_short: You can't go out in the daytime?
options: My boyfriends don't have to bring me home until dawn!
I'm mostly in school during the day anyway...
Hehe. Dawn, huh? Sounds kind of dangerous...
Oh... I was just joking around...
You seem like a pretty cool girl...
Here's my number... You should give me a call sometime.
You know, overall, you talk a pretty good game...
Maybe I'll see you around the arcade again sometime...
Anyway... I'd better get back to my game.
Hehe. I guess you taught me a thing or two.
Isn't that what people say when you totally sucked?
Uh... Maybe we should just move on and forget about boys.
So... What do we do now?
You're supposed to be an expert on skipping class!
Oh yeah. Well, we could go get some pizza or something.
Yes! I never get to eat pizza with Taylor and Paula.

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which girl do you like better?
How would you describe your friends?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, come on, then! Let's get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Mrs. Faulkner isn't going to let us talk during English class, so we'd better sneak out quick before she shows up!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hurry up! Grab your backpack, and let's go!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm too sad to hurry...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Then you'd better cheer up `real fast.` Let's go!
nodes.text_bbcode: Then you'd better cheer up [color=#3b78e2][i]real fast.[/i][/color] Let's go!

nodes.text: Help Linda cheer up and sneak out quickly before Mrs. Faulkner arrives!
Linda and Dinah try to hurry...
...And make it safely outside!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Nice! Now we can head to the graveyard and hang out for a while!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... I'm not really into... Graveyards.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But... Graveyards are awesome.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... Maybe we could go somewhere we'd both enjoy...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Like the mall!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well... I guess I could stop by `Cold Tropic.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... I guess I could stop by [color=#3b78e2][i]Cold Tropic.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Mrs. Faulkner!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Faulkner
nodes.text: Going somewhere, girls?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Faulkner
nodes.text: Good... Because I wouldn't want you to miss today's lecture!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Faulkner
nodes.text: We'll be learning all about `the semicolon!`
nodes.text_bbcode: We'll be learning all about [color=#3b78e2][i]the semicolon![/i][/color]

nodes.text: An hour later...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: My poor brain...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Tell me about it; I couldn't concentrate at all.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey! You just used a semicolon; I can't believe it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You just used one too!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I think we should get out of this school before we accidentally learn something else!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Good call...
Later, at the mall...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I feel kind of weird...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I've never skipped a class before.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, snap out of it.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: If you're going to break the rules, you might as well enjoy it, right?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I mean, I thought the whole point of this was so you could cheer up.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Tell you what. We'll skip Cold Tropic for now... I've got somewhere even more fun for us to go.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm taking you to the arcade!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Arcade?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It... It's just been a hard day.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well... I guess we could talk about it.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Really? I don't know... We're kind of, you know, strangers.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah... And usually when I have problems, I prefer to bottle them up until I explode...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh... Well... I don't want that to happen to me...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I mean... Maybe it would be nice to talk.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Waaaah!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh man... I can't even think with her bawling like that!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Will you `please` be quiet?! I'm trying to finish this essay before class starts!
nodes.text_bbcode: Will you [color=#3b78e2][i]please[/i][/color] be quiet?! I'm trying to finish this essay before class starts!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: How can I be quiet... When my life is over?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow... Sounds like you're going through some pretty dark emotions...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I feel so alone.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You... You do?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Do you want to... Hang out?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You... And me... Hang out?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Huh... It sounds like Little Miss Perfect is having a rough day.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What does she have to cry about, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: She does look really sad, though...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Should I say something?

options.label: Let her deal with her own problems.

nodes.text: Later, in class...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sniff...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: WHAT?!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: WHAT?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I see... You've made your choice.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess I have...
Linda sadly turns and walks away...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, I guess we'll have to tell everyone she's a kleptomaniac who steals other girls' underwear from the locker room!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Good call!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But first...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Pedicures!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Pedicures![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You've made the right choice.
Later...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... Howard? Can we talk?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure thing, Linda. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I can't hang out with you anymore.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, right! We're totally into each other.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I'm not kidding.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... I don't understand...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It... It's Kenji, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No... Actually, I'm going to ditch him too...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now I'm really confused.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I have to do this...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Goodbye, Howard...
Later...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... Kenji?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Um... I kind of... Can't hang out with you anymore.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I... I understand. You've chosen Howard.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: This is something Taylor and Paula said I should do.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Taylor and Paula... I thought they hated each other.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... They do... But as the two most popular girls in school, they still have to hang out with each other.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Even though Paula hired a guy to break Taylor's leg a couple of months ago?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Don't ask me to explain how they work...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Right. Well, clearly there's nothing more to say.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's for your own sake, you understand.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Of course `we` know you're a sweet, wholesome girl...
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course [color=#3b78e2][i]we[/i][/color] know you're a sweet, wholesome girl...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But other people... They tend to gossip.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: So what's it going to be?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I choose...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: K... Kenji?!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I... Think I'm going to be sick.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Hold my hair! `Hold my hair!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hold my hair! [color=#3b78e2][i]Hold my hair![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: It... It's okay.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: False alarm.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But... You've got to seriously reconsider your choice of boys!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: My health is at risk!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You'd better tell Kenji it's over... `Today!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You'd better tell Kenji it's over... [color=#3b78e2][i]Today![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: And do the same to Howard while you're at it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He is kind of tasty...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... I mean, you should go tell him it's over... `Today!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... I mean, you should go tell him it's over... [color=#3b78e2][i]Today![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: And ditch Kenji too!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Good... Then following our advice should be easy.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: 'Advice'?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: You need to tell both of them to never speak to you again!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Diary Entry. Wednesday...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'It's Senior year... Just the same as any other year, I guess.'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'There's still a little bit of summer in the air, and everywhere I go, people seem to be smiling.'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Until I come along...'
Dinah walks past Zach and Amanda... And the two stop smiling.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'It's not like I `want` to make people sad...'
nodes.text_bbcode: 'It's not like I [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] to make people sad...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'I guess seeing some lonely goth girl walking around friendless is just depressing...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Maybe I should just lose the black choker and get a fake tan...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Yeah right, though... I am who I am.'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'I mean, people like Zach and Amanda are all right...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'They're just a little brainwashed, that's all.'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Wearing shoes worth more than my car... Private tutors paid for... Everyone they know beautiful and evenly tanned...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'I mean... Why stop to reflect on your life when it's so perfect?'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'I just sometimes wish something would happen to one of those popular kids to wake them up...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Something to shock them out of their perfect little existences... To make them understand how I feel...'
In this pack you'll get a chance to play as both Dinah `and` Linda!
nodes.text_bbcode: In this pack you'll get a chance to play as both Dinah [b]and[/b] Linda!

nodes.text: We'll switch off who you're controlling based on the scene, so stay alert!
Outside...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Linda... I'm sorry, but it's time for an intervention.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: People have been talking...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...They're saying that you're still hanging out with Kenji!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: That guy is a `loser.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That guy is a [color=#3b78e2][i]loser.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You... You guys should give him a chance.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: He's actually a total sweetheart once you get past the oil-stained tank top...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I heard you kissed him... `So gross!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I heard you kissed him... [color=#3b78e2][i]So gross![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: You'd better be careful, Linda...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Your popularity is on thin ice already from hooking up with Howard on the 4th of July!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What are you talking about? Everyone loves Howard!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Not us!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You never complained about him until he came up with those nicknames for you...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: `'Tanning Bed Taylor'` and `'Pink Piggy Paula'.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]'Tanning Bed Taylor'[/i][/color] and [color=#3b78e2][i]'Pink Piggy Paula'.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's not funny!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: That's not funny!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Howard decided to start a `completely untrue` rumor that we go to the tanning salon too often!
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard decided to start a [color=#3b78e2][i]completely untrue[/i][/color] rumor that we go to the tanning salon too often!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: As a result, we are revoking his status of `cool guy.`
nodes.text_bbcode: As a result, we are revoking his status of [color=#3b78e2][i]cool guy.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Don't tell me you still `like` Howard!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't tell me you still [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] Howard!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... Honestly...

nodes.prompt: Don't tell me you still `like` Howard!

options.label: I'm not into either of them.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Don't tell me you still `like` Howard!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: You seem like a pretty cool girl...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Here's my number... You should give me a call sometime.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: You know, overall, you talk a pretty good game...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Maybe I'll see you around the arcade again sometime...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Anyway... I'd better get back to my game.
Dinah runs back to Linda.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Not bad, Dinah!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hehe. I guess you taught me a thing or two.
Dinah runs back to Linda.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... Good effort.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Isn't that what people say when you totally sucked?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yes... Yes it is.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... Maybe we should just move on and forget about boys.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So... What do we do now?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Huh? I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You're supposed to be an expert on skipping class!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh yeah. Well, we could go get some pizza or something.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yes! I never get to eat pizza with Taylor and Paula.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: A lot of the girls have been on this weird diet where you can only eat circular objects... Like Oranges and hamburger buns.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But pizzas are round too...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know... But the slices are triangles.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And you popular girls think `I'm` weird...
nodes.text_bbcode: And you popular girls think [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] weird...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Come on... Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Oh... I was just joking around...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hehe. Dawn, huh? Sounds kind of dangerous...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hehe. Dawn, huh? Sounds kind of dangerous...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Oh... I was just joking around...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: So... If you're, like, a vampire, does that mean you can't go out in the daytime?

options.label: My boyfriends don't have to bring me home until dawn!
I'm mostly in school during the day anyway...

nodes.text: You can't go out in the daytime?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Uh... I was just kidding...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh! A coffin! Like I'm a vampire or something! I get it now!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Uh... I was just kidding...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh! A coffin! Like I'm a vampire or something! I get it now!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Well... That doesn't sound so bad.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Room for two, huh?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: You're kind of funny for a girl who probably sleeps in a coffin.

options.label: Sleeping in coffins gives me splinters!
I sleep in a racecar bed!
My coffin just might have room for two...

nodes.text: You probably sleep in a coffin...

menu.title: You probably sleep in a coffin...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Uh... What? Are you joking?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hehe. My dreams, huh?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Uh... What? Are you joking?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm not trying to change anyone here...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Or to force you into doing something you don't want to do...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's exactly what I'm trying to escape from...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: People like Paula and Taylor who think they can make you do anything they want!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Is that what this is about? You're fighting with Paula and Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Something like that...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But I think I'm starting to realize I don't have to put up with them!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I mean, I've still got Howard and Kenji... And I'm hanging out with you now!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... So I think Phil is still looking at us...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Great! Then it's about time you went up and talked to him!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Face it... Guys just don't like goth girls.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Especially guys like Phil.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But... But my dad says I'm supposed to be myself!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Not if yourself is a loser!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You're just like all the other popular girls, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You want to change everyone else to be just like you!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, no, no, no...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You're just so pretty, and you've always got your arms crossed and a mean look on your face.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm sure a lot of guys are totally scared to come up and talk to you!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Huh... I never really thought about it that way...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Maybe I should adjust my attitude a little...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wait...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And I think he was checking you out!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Too bad for him... I'm already choosing between a couple of guys.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What about you... Who's your boyfriend?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I... I don't really... Have one.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's okay... We all have dry spells...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah... Except mine has lasted `seventeen years!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... Except mine has lasted [color=#3b78e2][i]seventeen years![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You've never had a boyfriend?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Don't say that so loud!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm really surprised, though!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess it must be because you're...

nodes.prompt: I guess it must be because you're...

menu.text: I guess it must be because you're...

nodes.text: Later...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I didn't know you were into video games...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, I'm not...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... I guess... It's kind of hard to admit...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But... I kind of come here to look at the guys.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Like that one!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh! I know that guy!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's Phil. He totally used to date Mallika...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But they're broken up now...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: He's a total hottie...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: C... Coming!
And so, later, back at Paula's place...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: You `definitely` made the right choice hanging out with me instead of that gothy loser.
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]definitely[/i][/color] made the right choice hanging out with me instead of that gothy loser.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So... What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Let's play the `ratings game!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's play the [color=#3b78e2][i]ratings game![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... What's that?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Well, we make a list of people we know, and then rate them from 1 to 100 based on looks, general coolness, fashion sense, and smell!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Smell?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Let's start with Taylor... What's her smell rating?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Are you kidding?! She's a total 43!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But maybe you can't tell... Since you're a smell-rating 27...
Wow... After all that time trying to make friends with Dinah, Linda just ditched her at the mall...
We're not going to rate your smell... But we can definitely tell you that this was a `stinky` performance.
nodes.text_bbcode: We're not going to rate your smell... But we can definitely tell you that this was a [b]stinky[/b] performance.

nodes.text: Try again from the beginning, and see if you can earn a better ending!

args.text: Don't let things end like this! Play again!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: N... No.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm hanging out with Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's about time you stopped acting like the queen of the school.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: As I remember, you `lost` the last popularity contest you entered.
nodes.text_bbcode: As I remember, you [color=#3b78e2][i]lost[/i][/color] the last popularity contest you entered.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: How `dare you` bring up homecoming?!
nodes.text_bbcode: How [color=#3b78e2][i]dare you[/i][/color] bring up homecoming?!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: You're making the wrong enemy, Linda.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Enjoy your `triangular pizza!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Enjoy your [color=#3b78e2][i]triangular pizza![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I'm sure it won't make you fat.
Paula walks off.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I think I just lost my appetite.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Let's get out of this mall, okay?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Good call. Know anywhere we can go?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Actually... I think I know just the place!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I guess I should have seen this coming...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: First you chose those awful boys over your own dignity...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: And now you've hit a new low... Hanging out with a vampire!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm not a vampire...
Later...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Oh... So you `are` on a diet.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh... So you [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] on a diet.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Well, that's what I tell Taylor and Paula...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But actually, it's because I saw this documentary on factory farms that made me reconsider how we treat animals.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Huh...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: You know... You're actually kind of deep...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: For a popular girl, I mean.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Linda!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... I've been thinking for the last few minutes...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And I... I'm going to go beg Taylor and Paula to be friends with me again!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No offense, Dinah, but hanging out with you made me realize just how important popularity really is!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: If I don't do something to save my social future now, I'm going to end up like you!
Linda shudders.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You mean... My life really is as bad as I think it is?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No... It's actually way worse.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You basically should just start over from scratch... Move to a new town. Buy a wig.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Maybe change your name to something like 'Amber'.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Burn all your current clothes and buy some new ones...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And maybe get a hypnotist to give you a complete personality adjustment.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You... You really think I should do all that?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No... I was just trying to be helpful.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Even if you did all that stuff, you'd still probably be uncool...
Wow... This has turned into kind of a downer.
Were you trying to make the girls have a bad time?
Or are you just the kind of a person who makes bad decisions?
Either way, we'd start over from the beginning...

args.text: Wow... You really need to step up your game!

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: Later...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well... School has been over for about an hour now. I guess we're not technically skipping anymore.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: So... What are you doing now?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I can't believe you build sandcastles!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That's for babies!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No... No, it's not.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I shouldn't have brought you here...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh... Uh... Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Let's... Let's just go, okay.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Don't worry. Your secret's safe with me.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hehe. Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, I guess we'd better get to work!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh wow! That tower is looking awesome.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Thanks. Are you almost done with the moat?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Whoa... What are those?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: They're little alligators. To eat intruders.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hehe. Cool.
Later...

nodes.character: Wow! So how did you first find this beach?
I got lost on this hike and ended up here... No one really knows about it.
I come here sometimes when I want to get away from everyone.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... So... You want to... Build a sandcastle?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's what I like to do here, okay?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.prompt: That's what I like to do here, okay?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: That's what I like to do here, okay?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Lucky for you, I'm willing to overlook this slip-up and take you to `American Beagle` to buy a new shirt.
nodes.text_bbcode: Lucky for you, I'm willing to overlook this slip-up and take you to [color=#3b78e2][i]American Beagle[/i][/color] to buy a new shirt.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Let's go.
Think Dinah has the guts to actually talk to Phil? Play as her and find out!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: T... Talk to `Phil?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: T... Talk to [color=#3b78e2][i]Phil?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No way! He's totally out of my league!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Come on... Talking to guys is easy!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You just have to figure out what they're interested in.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But how do I know that?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: By instinct!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Tell you what. Here's a little game to practice...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'll name a type of guy... And you guess what kind of stuff he might be into.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ready... Go!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: ...And an emo guy would want to talk about whatever band he's in!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wait... That's a good start... But I actually tend to like more complex guys...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Like... A football player that's also really good at playing the guitar...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And maybe has a tattoo!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hmm... Now that I think about it, when I talk to Kenji or Howard, it's about all kinds of stuff.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wait... So then what do I talk to Phil about?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Just be flirty and kind of fun!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: F... Fun?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But... Some goth guys totally `love` football!
nodes.text_bbcode: But... Some goth guys totally [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] football!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess that's kind of right, actually...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I mean... It seems like this 'system' of yours totally doesn't take the complexity of the individual into account!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But... That still doesn't get me any closer to being able to talk to Phil...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No... No, it doesn't.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean I'm letting you off the hook!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, Phil!
Phil looks over at Linda and Dinah...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Time to show me what you've got!
Dinah walks up to Phil.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Hi.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I like your, uh... Pool cue?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Uh... Heh. Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Code red! Code red! I've got to step up my flirting here!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I uh... Like your shoes.

options.label: They're all worn out from walking through your dreams!

nodes.text: I like your shoes...
Later...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I didn't know you were into video games...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, I'm not...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... I guess... It's kind of hard to admit...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But... I kind of come here to look at the guys.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Like that one!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh! I know that guy!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's Phil. He totally used to date Mallika...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But they're broken up now...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: He's a total hottie...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey... Don't be so hard on yourself! You're super cute. Maybe you just need a couple of pointers.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You should totally go talk to Phil!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm... Not a good person.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Shoot... Don't like... Cry.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I mean... The fact that you feel guilty must mean you're at least kind of self-aware!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And... I'm sure you can still get one of those guys if that's what you really want.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You... Really think so?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I mean... Not that I know anything about getting together with guys...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: If you're bitter because you can't get a guy, why don't you `do something about it?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: If you're bitter because you can't get a guy, why don't you [color=#3b78e2][i]do something about it?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That might be a little more productive than yelling at me!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Don't you think I already feel terrible about what happened with Kenji and Howard?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Sorry... I guess I just have a little... Pent-up hostility.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I understand that... But seriously, you've got to let that go.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That attitude is probably half the reason you have trouble with guys in the first place.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You... You're right! No guy could ever want me!

options.label: You're just taking your own problems out on me.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess I could go talk to him... I won't be dating Howard or Kenji anytime soon...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh... So that's why you're so upset today?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Getting dumped does suck... Or so I've heard, anyway. It must really suck to get dumped by `two` guys!
nodes.text_bbcode: Getting dumped does suck... Or so I've heard, anyway. It must really suck to get dumped by [color=#3b78e2][i]two[/i][/color] guys!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh... Actually, I dumped them...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Or, more like, pre-dumped before we could even start.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But I didn't want to pre-dump them!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Paula and Taylor made me do it!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What do you mean they 'made you'?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Er... Well... They implied I might not be as popular if I dated those guys...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And you ditched two guys because of that?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You... You chose popularity over two decent guys who care about you?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Gosh... That makes me sound kind of... Shallow.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You think?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You know what... You deserve to be sad!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Some of us would kill just to have `one` nice guy look our way...
nodes.text_bbcode: Some of us would kill just to have [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] nice guy look our way...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And then girls like you dump `two` decent guys just because the other popular kids tell you to!
nodes.text_bbcode: And then girls like you dump [color=#3b78e2][i]two[/i][/color] decent guys just because the other popular kids tell you to!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You know what...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: What are you doing here with that... `Thing?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you doing here with that... [color=#3b78e2][i]Thing?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm not a 'thing'...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Ew... It's bad enough you kissed Kenji and Howard...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But now you're at the mall with a `goth girl?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But now you're at the mall with a [color=#3b78e2][i]goth girl?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Actually... I think I've got a couple of apologies to make.
Later, Linda goes to the Auto-Shop to find Kenji...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji... I'm sorry I said we couldn't hang out anymore.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: So... Does this mean... You've chosen me over Howard?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Er... Not exactly.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... This is more like me telling you that you can still compete for me!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Oh wow... What an awesome privilege.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Thanks but no thanks.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh well... At least this makes my decision easy.
Later, at Howard's house...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard! Great news...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I `will` go out with y...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]will[/i][/color] go out with y...

nodes.text: Linda runs into Howard's room and sees Howard with Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... What is `she` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... What is [color=#3b78e2][i]she[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Taylor is consoling me...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: From when `you` broke my heart!
nodes.text_bbcode: From when [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] broke my heart!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: `'Consoling'?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]'Consoling'?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hehe. Don't take it so personally, Linda.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: RAWR!
Sorry to cut away, but that was going to be an awfully grisly scene...
You'd better play this one again... And help Linda be a little nicer to the men in her life!

args.text: We know you can do better! Try again!

nodes.text: You really played a good game...
Just not good enough to get the bonus scene!
Want to try again and see what's up with Howard and Kenji?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... I was supposed to go shoe shopping with Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But maybe you can come along!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: R... Really?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But wait... Amanda is a popular girl. She's not going to want to hang out with me!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: `I'm` a popular girl. And I'm totally vouching for your coolness.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] a popular girl. And I'm totally vouching for your coolness.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Plus, Amanda is a total sweetheart.
And so, back at the mall...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sniff...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Amanda? Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I... I just don't know what to do...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I was hanging out with Paula and Taylor earlier... And they said I need to dump Zach!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: They... They said that I don't look good next to a blond guy!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... Listen. Taylor and Paula aren't here.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And Dinah and I don't care who you date.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: R... Really?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Really.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You guys are the best!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Now who wants to get some pizza... Without Paula there to ruin our meal?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm in!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! I'll get a little personal pan one so I can stay on the 'Round Foods Diet'!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Diary Entry. Wednesday. `Revised.`'
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Diary Entry. Wednesday. [color=#3b78e2][i]Revised.[/i][/color]'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Rereading what I wrote earlier today kind of makes me cringe...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'I guess it's easy to go through life assuming everyone around you is shallow and soulless...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'But everyone has their problems...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'And sometimes when you take a second to get to know someone...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'They can genuinely surprise you...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'And some girl you think you hate...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Well, by the end of the day...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'She could be your friend.'
It looks like a nice ending for Dinah and Linda.
But things are a little more tense elsewhere...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey... Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ummm...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I just wanted to ask about you and Linda.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Do you like her?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: We see who she picks.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So I guess... Game on?
Kenji wipes his oil-covered hands onto his shirt.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Game on.
Wow! Looks like Linda just might have a tough choice ahead!
Stay tuned in the weeks ahead to see who gets the girl!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... I'll probably just head home and watch 'America's Next Best Beatboxer'.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh man... I love that show.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh... Huh.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: See... Uh... I think maybe it's just best we go our separate ways.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah... I mean, you're probably right.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You know... Nothing personal. Just... You're kind of... Different.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah... Yeah... So I've been told.
The next day, Dinah sees Linda walking with Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey, Linda! What's up?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... Do I know you?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It... It's me, Dinah. We hung out all day yesterday.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... I'm pretty sure that didn't happen.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah... I'm pretty sure Linda wouldn't have done that.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No... We... We ate pizza! `Triangular pizza!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No... We... We ate pizza! [color=#3b78e2][i]Triangular pizza![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh no... She's totally delusional.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Don't cast a spell on us!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I don't cast... Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I guess girls like you would just never understand...
Wow... This isn't exactly the best way things could have turned out.
Try again, and see if you can help Linda and Dinah actually become friends!

args.text: You're getting closer... Give it another try!
